items.title: Hampden Risk Partners appoints Danny Milnes as Head of Exposure Management
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, hampden Risk Partners, operating through Syndicate 2689 at Lloyd's, has appointed Danny Milnes to lead its exposure management function.

items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorized clone firm pinnaclesweb.com
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has warned consumers against dealing with pinnaclesweb.com, an unauthorized clone of genuine firm Pinnacle Wealth Management LLP.

items.title: Schroders adds ten staff to ETF team to support active product demand
items.summary: According to Investment Week, schroders has hired ten new employees for its exchange-traded fund team to meet growing client demand across key European markets.

items.title: Motive Partners completes acquisition of Mobius from Phoenix Equity Partners
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, private investment company Motive Partners has finalized its purchase of investment platform provider Mobius following regulatory approval.

items.title: Mixed industry concern over potential tax relief changes for UK investment
items.summary: A Professional Pensions survey reveals split opinion on whether upcoming Budget tax relief changes could be used to mandate pension scheme investment in UK assets.

items.title: NAIC reports growth in US domestic cyber insurance market
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, u.S. domestic direct premiums written for cyber insurance reached nearly $7.5 billion in 2025, while endorsement policies accounted for the majority of policies in force.
